name: ai-slop
description: Audits a codebase's user-facing copy, layouts and metadata for AI-written tells and factual errors, such as a privacy policy that misses the trackers the code loads, reviews a web, iOS or Android screen for AI-generated design and fixes it in ordered passes once you approve a direction, rewrites a file or pasted text to remove AI writing patterns, prunes code comments that narrate the code or excuse a workaround, and rebuilds a feature an agent just wrote as a simpler second version, keeping the first until you choose
